subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Should `models.providers.fal.request.allowPrivateNetwork` be allowed to opt FAL generation submission requests into private-network access, while generated-media downloads remain strictly guarded?
rationale: The current helper explicitly denies private-network access, but the existing model-provider request contract includes an opt-in; changing precedence broadens an SSRF-sensitive network boundary and needs an owner-confirmed intent.

options.title: Honor explicit opt-in
options.body: Remove or rework the caller-level denial so the sanitized configured opt-in applies to FAL submission requests, with regression tests proving downloads remain separately guarded.

options.title: Keep FAL submissions strict
options.body: Preserve the unconditional denial and narrow the PR’s claims and coverage so private-network policy is explicitly unsupported for FAL media submissions.

recommendation.title: Honor explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Remove or rework the caller-level denial so the sanitized configured opt-in applies to FAL submission requests, with regression tests proving downloads remain separately guarded.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared FAL HTTP helper and authored recent runtime request-override behavior governing this boundary.
